concerns.text: Task T012 (runtime enforcement) is placed after the pipeline tasks it is supposed to wrap. As a producer of the runtime limit enforcement, it must run *before* or wrap the downstream tasks (download, align, preprocess, bias audit, train, evaluate, validate). Current ordering means the limit cannot be enforced, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

Tasks marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) actually depend on the directory structure created by T001 (logs/ and results/). They also rely on artifacts produced by earlier tasks (e.g., T013 needs all major outputs). Therefore they are not truly parallel‑safe; running them concurrently with T001 or before its completion would cause failures. The `[P]` tag is unsafe here.
